question: At the Sportster East sports conclave 2023, which Indian women's cricket player received the Emerging Hero award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Titas Sadhu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Titas Sadhu** received the** Emerging Hero award **at the **Sportster East sports conclave 2023.**
 
• Titas Sadhu is an** Indian women's cricket player** who has been making headlines for her impressive performances on the field.
 
• She played for the Indian squad that won the** 2023 U19 Women's T20 World Cup**, and she was named **Player of the Match** in the championship game.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Richa Ghosa** is also an **Indian women's cricket player** who has represented the country in international matches.
 
• **Harleen Deol **is another **Indian women's cricket player** who has been making waves in the sport.
 
 
• She is known for her all-round abilities and has represented India in** both ODIs and T20Is.**
 
 
 
• **Deepti Sharma** is a **top-order batter and off-spinner **who has played for the Indian women's cricket team.
 
 
• She has been a consistent performer for the team and has also been a part of the** Women's Big Bash League** in **Australia.**
